adds.title: Cape Verdean Institute for Gender Equality and Equity (ICIEG) and Praia Government - 2018 Praia Pride
adds.summary: Praia held LGBTI Pride Week in June 2018 with support from the Cape Verdean Institute for Gender Equality and Equity (ICIEG) and the City Hall featuring a city-centre parade, debates at UniCV and a community photo exhibition while LGBTI associations advanced a petition for an equal-treatment and non-discrimination law explicitly covering sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression.
